title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 10: Smiling One Second

scenes.say: Morning. Alarm blares. Gunfire in the distance. Ali suits up fast, hands steady.
scenes.visual: a soldier strapping on body armor quickly in a tent, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The scariest part of war? Ain't the bullets. It's how normal it starts to feel.
scenes.visual: an empty cot with a helmet resting on it, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Weeks later. Dusk. A calm day. The squad jokes around.
scenes.visual: soldiers walking on patrol at dusk, relaxed, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a soldier at the back of a patrol line, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a blinding explosion of dust at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Screams. Dust. Ali on the ground, ears ringing. He looks over. Roddy is motionless.
scenes.visual: dust settling over a road, a fallen helmet, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a soldier crawling through dust toward a fallen comrade, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Mack: Move, soldier! We're under attack!
scenes.visual: soldiers taking cover in smoke, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: And just like that, he was gone. Smiling one second. Gone the next.
scenes.visual: an empty helmet lying in the sand as smoke drifts, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Eleven. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: dog tags lying in the sand at sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 10 of 25: Smiling One Second. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
